# Grand Strand Ally GEO

> AI visibility (Generative Engine Optimization) for local service businesses in the Grand Strand / Myrtle Beach, SC area.

Grand Strand Ally helps owners understand and improve how AI tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini describe and recommend their businesses. Start with a free assessment; optional month-to-month plans follow.

## What GEO means

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is the work of making a business easy for AI tools to understand, trust and recommend. SEO ranks pages in a list of links; GEO aims to be named in the written answer AI gives.

## Service area

- Grand Strand, South Carolina
- Myrtle Beach, SC and nearby coastal communities

## Services / plans

All plans are month-to-month and cancel anytime. Every engagement starts with the free assessment.

1. Monitor — $199/month
   - Monthly visibility snapshot
   - Score refresh
   - Priority recommendations
   - Monthly email summary

2. Growth (recommended) — from $499/month
   - Everything in Monitor
   - Monthly live review call
   - Written briefs for 1–3 key pages
   - Action summary of what to ship
   - Up to 1 hour/month of draft review or page edits

3. Managed — from $1,250/month
   - Everything in Growth
   - Hands-on implementation on priority pages
   - Content planning for the month ahead
   - Roadmap review each billing cycle

4. Custom — scoped for multi-location or larger footprints
